what: interior background runs per archetype per register, at three pipeline stages

method.gap: a run of transparent pixels with opaque pixels on both sides of it in the same row
method.bands: upper 60% of drawn height is arms/torso, lower 40% is legs
method.stages: render = Blender alpha; quantized = palette + consolidation; shipped = decoded back out of the atlas PNG the browser loads
method.contour: the ink pass dilates the silhouette 1 px on all eight neighbours, so it closes an interior gap from both sides: a 3 px render gap ships as 1 px, a 2 px gap ships as nothing
method.facings: all eight idle facings; every figure is reported as a count of facings that keep the gap, never as the best one
